== Course of events ==

After Glinda, Ozma, the Scarecrow, and their guard flew the Gump into the palace courtyard and captured her, General Jinjur had refused to surrender her throne, declaring war on Glinda and Ozma rather than yield. It is in the aftermath of that defiance that Old Mombi confessed, and with her confession came the revelation that Tip is truly Princess Ozma. On learning of Mombi's confession and of Tip's true identity as Ozma, Queen Jinjur despairs.

The despair that follows this revelation marks the collapse of Jinjur's position: the Army of Revolt would go on to surrender, the stolen jewels would be returned, and Ozma would be crowned Queen of the Emerald City. General Jinjur, Old Mombi, the Queen, and Tip stand at the center of this turning point, as Mombi's confession settles the question of Tip's identity and closes the conflict that Jinjur's refusal to give up her throne had opened.
